comments.issue: Fatal Error: Call to undefined method Mistralys\X4\Database\Ships\ShipDefs::find()
comments.details: The test test_multiBuilderFaction() attempts to call $ships->find('ship_gen_m_corvette_01'), but ShipDefs does not have a find() method. ShipDefs only has getByID(string $id): ShipDef (via @method annotation from BaseStringPrimaryCollection).
comments.fix_required: Change line 86 from: $envoy = $ships->find('ship_gen_m_corvette_01'); TO: $envoy = $ships->getByID('ship_gen_m_corvette_01'); OR implement a find() method in ShipDefs similar to ModuleDefs::find() and ShieldDefs::find().

pipelines.summary: QA FAILED - Critical runtime error in test_multiBuilderFaction(). Test calls non-existent ShipDefs::find() method instead of getByID(). Test cannot execute until this is fixed. Implementation code (WP-001 through WP-005) appears correct based on code inspection: ShipDef has all required methods (getBuilderFactionID(), getBuilderFactionIDs(), getBuilderFactions(), hasMultipleBuilderFactions()), ShipFinder::isMatch() correctly uses array_intersect(), ShipDefs::getFactions() correctly iterates through getBuilderFactionIDs(). The bug is isolated to the test implementation only.
